subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the security and release workflow owners accept this grouped set of executable action updates after the direct Codex check and exact-head validation are complete?
rationale: Several touched workflows execute third-party code with app private keys, registry credentials, security-event write access, or OpenAI API keys, and CODEOWNERS reserves key paths for explicit security review.

options.title: Approve the grouped update
options.body: Accept all official immutable pins together after the branch is refreshed, exact-head validation passes, and required security and release owners approve.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, Blacksmith, and Codex updates from routine toolchain actions to allow narrower owner review and rollback.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the existing pins until the failed shards and the uncompleted direct Codex inspection can be resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped update
recommendation.body: Accept all official immutable pins together after the branch is refreshed, exact-head validation passes, and required security and release owners approve.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest cross-cutting ownership of action modernization, docs-agent automation, and Docker release workflow behavior.
